rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3BB label and notes fair-quality blastocyst features, but it overstates confidence in visible ICM/TE detail and zona thinning from this single image.

Integrates age, AMH, prior live birth/biochemical pregnancy, smoking, BMI, sperm parameters, and endometrium with embryo quality in a clinically meaningful way, though some links are somewhat speculative.

Overall structure is logical, but several claims are overstated or weakly supported (e.g., smoking effect magnitude, stress effects, estradiol supplementation rationale, baseline probability calculations).

Appropriately supports single embryo transfer and smoking cessation, but recommendations such as routine PGT-A at age 29, ERA/EndomeTRIO after limited failure, GH/DHEA, acupuncture, and aspirin are not strongly guideline-based.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and future planning, but some suggested interventions are not evidence-based enough to merit stronger endorsement.
